History's most famous seductress spy may never have been a spy at all.
Then why is she so famous?
Paris, nineteen oh five. A Dutch dancer calls herself Mata Hari, and powerful men fall for her.
In the First World War, a German consul paid her twenty thousand francs. Her code name: H twenty-one.
She took the money. Then she offered to spy for France, for a million francs.
In nineteen seventeen, France arrested her in Paris. Months later, she faced a firing squad.
Years later, the men who convicted her admitted the evidence was thin.
